environment.description: IoT message broker running on bare EC2 instance (c5.xlarge) with Flask behind gunicorn (sync workers, 4 threads). Direct TLS termination at application layer. No reverse proxy or API gateway in front. Network path: Device -> Internet -> EC2 Security Group (port 8443 open) -> gunicorn -> Flask app. Average network jitter on same-region measurement: ~0.2ms. Timing differences of 50-200ns per character are extractable with ~10,000-50,000 samples per character position using statistical methods (Crosby et al.).
